잠언 8:1.content: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

잠언 8:2.content: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

잠언 8:3.content: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

잠언 8:4.content: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

잠언 8:5.content: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

잠언 8:6.content: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

잠언 8:7.content: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

잠언 8:8.content: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

잠언 8:9.content: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

잠언 8:10.content: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

잠언 8:11.content: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

잠언 8:12.content: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

잠언 8:13.content: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

잠언 8:14.content: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

잠언 8:15.content: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

잠언 8:16.content: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

잠언 8:17.content: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

잠언 8:18.content: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

잠언 8:19.content: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

잠언 8:20.content: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

잠언 8:21.content: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

잠언 8:22.content: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

잠언 8:23.content: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

잠언 8:24.content: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

잠언 8:25.content: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

잠언 8:26.content: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

잠언 8:27.content: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

잠언 8:28.content: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

잠언 8:29.content: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

잠언 8:30.content: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

잠언 8:31.content: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

잠언 8:32.content: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

잠언 8:33.content: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

잠언 8:34.content: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

잠언 8:35.content: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.

잠언 8:36.content: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
